decisions.reason: The submitted text contains multiple numbered positions requiring new physical products. The items below exclude temporary site provisions, services, documents, removal, reused materials, and hourly work.

items.material_name: Meadow grass seed mixture
items.description: 02.0004: Seed mixture for revegetating disturbed meadow areas, to be agreed with the landowner.

items.description: 02.0009: Gravel for 120° bedding, 15 cm bedding thickness, sidefill, and cover extending 20 cm above the pipe crown.

items.material_name: C12/15 concrete for 20 cm inlet structure bedding
items.description: 02.0010: Concrete for the inlet structure support bed, placed to grade and compacted.

items.material_name: 0/X cohesive pit-run gravel, non-frost-resistant
items.description: 02.0012: Cohesive bank gravel for trench soil replacement.

items.material_name: Utility reinstatement material, type unspecified

items.material_name: Utility reinstatement material, type unspecified
items.description: 02.0015: The preceding supply requirement also applies to longitudinal utilities within the excavation.

items.material_name: C 200/400 riprap stone
items.description: 02.0020: Riprap for streambank protection, including fine gravel or sand to fill voids between stones.

items.description: 02.0021: Compacted frost-protection base aggregate; minimum Ev2 is 120 MN/m².

items.material_name: 0/22 mm road shoulder gravel, 5–8 cm layer
items.description: 02.0026: Compacted shoulder aggregate for widths up to 50 cm and a 6% crossfall.
